build_n8n_pipeline_class: build an n8n agent pipeline class that integrates with n8n webhooks for custom AI workflows
run_pipe_function: run the pipe method to send a user message to an n8n workflow and stream the response chunks
configure_pipeline_init: configure the pipeline with api_url, api_key, ssl verification, and debug mode via __init__
test_inlet_hook: test the inlet hook to modify request body before the OpenAI API request is made
review_outlet_hook: review the outlet hook to process and modify messages after the OpenAI API response is received
